title: Largest Time for Given Digits
summary: Given an array of four digits, determine the latest 24-hour time format 'HH:MM' that can be formed using each digit exactly once.
statement: Given an array of four digits, determine the latest 24-hour time format 'HH:MM' that can be formed using each digit exactly once. The time must be between 00:00 and 23:59. If no valid time can be formed, return an empty string.
constraints: Use all four digits exactly once as HH:MM in 24-hour time.
Return the largest valid time or an empty string.
hints: Only 24 permutations exist, so direct enumeration is reliable and clear.
Filter arrangements by hour<24 and minute<60.
Choose the lexicographically/numerically largest valid digit tuple and format it.
Every legal use of the four digits is a permutation and tuple order matches clock order.
editorial: Every legal use of the four digits is a permutation and tuple order matches clock order.

tests.explanation: No permutation forms an hour below 24, so return an empty string.
